articles.title: NATO Summit Ends with $80 Billion Pledge for Ukraine and a Surprising Trump-Zelenskyy Moment
articles.summary: NATO allies committed 70 billion euros in military aid to Ukraine for 2026. In a friendly joint appearance, Trump offered to share Patriot missile technology, a stark shift from past tensions. Zelenskyy also secured drone deals with several nations.

articles.title: How a Small Circle of Trump Allies Fast-Tracked a 250-Foot Arch on the National Mall
articles.summary: A proposed triumphal arch near the Lincoln Memorial bypassed standard public review. The design originated from a tight-knit group of classical architecture enthusiasts with direct ties to Trump and the commission that approved it.

articles.title: Appeals Court Rejects Trump's Bid to Keep His Name on the Kennedy Center
articles.summary: A federal appeals court denied Trump's emergency request to halt the removal of his name from the Kennedy Center. Judges ruled he failed to prove irreparable harm, noting the name is already gone and his financial claims lacked evidence.
